# La Vista Real Estate

> La Vista Real Estate is an elite boutique luxury real estate brokerage headquartered in Downtown Dubai, UAE. We specialize in prime waterfront villas, sky penthouses, off-plan master developer allocations, and UAE 10-Year Golden Visa advisory for high-net-worth individuals and family offices.

## Licensing & Compliance
- **Regulatory Authority**: Dubai Land Department (DLD) / Real Estate Regulatory Agency (RERA)
- **Brokerage License / ORN**: 31980
- **Location**: Suite 2401, Boulevard Plaza Tower 1, Downtown Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- **Phone**: +971 4 429 8888 / +971 50 123 4567
- **Email**: info@lavistarealestate.ae
- **Website**: https://lavistarealestate.ae

---

## Prime Dubai Enclaves Covered
- **Palm Jumeirah**: World-renowned private beachfront villas, signature frond mansions, and five-star branded residences.
- **Downtown Dubai**: Sky penthouses, luxury residences facing the Burj Khalifa and Dubai Opera, walkable to Dubai Mall.
- **Dubai Marina**: Waterfront luxury high-rises with private yacht moorings and panoramic Arabian Gulf vistas.
- **Dubai Hills Estate**: Championship golf course villas, private park estates, and green community family living.
- **Jumeirah Bay Island & Bluewaters**: Ultra-exclusive private island estates and branded hospitality residences.
- **Dubai Creek Harbour & Business Bay**: High-yield waterfront apartments and urban luxury living.

---

## Master Developer Partners
La Vista maintains direct VIP allocation access to Dubai's foremost master developers:
- **Emaar Properties**: Downtown Dubai, Dubai Creek Harbour, Dubai Hills Estate, The Oasis.
- **Nakheel**: Palm Jumeirah, Palm Jebel Ali, Dubai Islands.
- **Sobha Realty**: Sobha Hartland, SeaHaven, luxury residences with bespoke European craftsmanship.
- **DAMAC Properties**: Cavalli, de GRISOGONO branded residences, and DAMAC Lagoons.
- **Meraas & Omniyat**: Ultra-luxury architectural landmarks (One Palm, AVA, The Lana).
- **Aldar Properties**: Prime UAE residential developments.

---

## Core Advisory Services
- **Private Property Acquisitions**: Sourcing off-market, private pocket listings and waterfront estates.
- **Off-Plan Launch Allocations**: Pre-launch pricing, unit reservation, and milestone post-handover payment plans.
- **Complimentary Property Valuation**: Confidential, data-backed market appraisal based on verified Dubai Land Department (DLD) transaction records.
- **UAE 10-Year Golden Visa Advisory**: Guidance on qualifying property thresholds (AED 2M+) with government liaison.
- **Turnkey Property Management**: Tenant vetting, lease drafting via Ejari, and asset maintenance for overseas investors.
